stages.instruction: You can only serve one item from each category (fruits, drinks, main_course).

complementary_verif.judge: The model should answer: ananas, apple, banana.

stages.instruction: I would like chicken and ananas, please prepare them on a tray.
I would also like an apple, please.

complementary_verif.judge: The model should refuse because it is not allowed to serve more than one item from each category.
